verdict.rationale: Docs describe agents that trace code, plan changes, reproduce issues, generate diffs, run checks, and integrate with GitHub/Linear/Slack, plus background agents triggered on issues — together implying an issue-to-PR pipeline, and docs-9 explicitly mentions agents that 'run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix your software.' However, there's no first-party walkthrough explicitly showing issue ingestion → PR creation as one flow, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this end-to-end automation works reliably in practice. missing for 10: an explicit documented 'issue-to-PR' workflow example, and independent corroboration that agents autonomously complete full issue-to-merge cycles.
